player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin Nim. Burin ku shine ɗaukar abu na ƙarshe da ya rage. A kowane juyi, zaɓi daidai ɗaya kuma cire abu ɗaya ko fiye daga ciki. Yi amfani da tsari '[pile quantity]', inda tari shine ƙididdigar tari kuma adadi shine adadin abubuwan da za a cire. Misali, '[0 3]' yana cire abubuwa 3 daga tari 0.
